title: Politeness, Hedging, and Nuanced Debate in Hungarian
grammar: Diplomatic hedging, nuanced refutation, and stance qualification (ha szabad úgy fogalmaznom, indokolt volna megfontolni)
goal: I can soften a criticism with célszerű lenne and indokolt volna
